 <div class="u_1885042527 dmRespRow" style="text-align: center;" id="1885042527"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1936570174"> <div class="u_1681270400 dmRespCol small-12 medium-12 large-12" id="1681270400" data-anim-desktop="fadeInUp"> <div class="u_1321182104 dmNewParagraph" id="1321182104" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s; text-align: center;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h1 class="text-align-left size-30 m-size-24"><strong style="font-style: normal; text-decoration: underline; font-weight: bold; display: initial;" class="font-size-30 m-font-size-24">PRIMAL LIFE</strong></h1> 
 <h1 class="m-size-14 text-align-left size-18"><span style="font-weight:500;display:initial;font-family:Alegreya, 'Alegreya Fallback';font-style:normal;" class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18">Downwinder &amp; roadtrip</span></h1> 
 <h1 class="text-align-center"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: 400;">&nbsp;</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h1> 
</div> <div class="u_1971690327 dmNewParagraph" id="1971690327" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h4 class="text-align-center"><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: initial;">&quot;Fair Winds and Following Seas&quot;</span></h4> 
</div> <div class="u_1440505187 dmNewParagraph" id="1440505187" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; border-image: none 100% / 1 / 0 stretch; display: block; float: none; text-align: center;" data-version="5"><p class="m-text-align-left text-align-center"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(236, 232, 232);">Discover the Kenyan coastline, best kept kitespots, waves &amp; flat and lovely kiteclubs combined with fat downwinders!</span></p><p class="text-align-center m-text-align-left"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> <div class="u_1970845985 dmNewParagraph" id="1970845985" style="transition: none; display: block;" data-version="5"> <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">Incl</span><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">,</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="text-align-left m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Full&nbsp; guided road&nbsp; backup/transport. (people, bagage, gear,.. ) *The bus will always leave after the downwind kiters.</span><span style="color: rgb(236, 232, 232); display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14"><br/></span></h5> 
 <h5 class="text-align-left m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Overnight stay in shared rooms. (upgrade single)</span><span style="color: rgb(236, 232, 232); display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14"><br/></span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Guided on the water and on land.</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Bfast always incl.</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-All staff needed.</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-2 guides on the water.</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-The 7 best kitespots will be visited &amp; 5 downwinders.</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Transfer from Nyali to Mambrui on the first day of the kitecamp.</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Last day return to airport Diani or Mombasa</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="text-align-left"><span style="color: rgb(236, 232, 232); display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14"><br/></span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">Not incl,</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">-Lunch, dinner, drinks,</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18">-Visa</span></h5> 
 <h5 class="m-size-14 size-18"><span style="display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18">-Flight to Nairobi or Mombasa</span></h5> 
 <h5><span style="color: rgb(236, 232, 232); display: initial; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14"><br/></span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h5>
